Songhurst, B. (2018). LNG Plant Cost Reduction 2014-18. OIES Paper NG 137, Oxford Institute for Energy Studies, October 2018. ISBN 978-1-78467-120-4. DOI 10.26889/9781784671204.

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 6 for the body; front matter is roman). Loaded: all 25 plant/train examples of Appendix 1 (liquefaction-plant capex per tpa and capacity; project incl-upstream cost per tpa kept in _other-values), the 13 author-proposed average unit costs of Table 3 as separate planning examples (the author pro-rates several cells; Table 4 per-mmbtu and Table 7 production costs in _other-values), opex per tpa for four plants from Table 6 (OPEX including fuel gas at $5/mmbtu; non-fuel opex in _other-values), fuel gas consumption (10-12% of feed gas; Sabine Pass 9.5%; printed as percent of feed gas, not converted to GJ/GJ because feed-gas and LNG heating-value bases are not given). Costs are US dollars of unstated price year (projects built 2014-18; publication year 2018 used and flagged). Trap: liquefaction capex excludes upstream; project totals include it. Appendix 1 gives Bintulu T9 as Indonesia but the text places it in Sarawak, Malaysia. Cost units mix tpa and mmbtu: Table 4 conversion printed as "0.035%" (unclear). No emissions or GHG figures. Complexity/location factors (Fig. 4-5, 13-14, 16) and Tables 8-9 are chart or comparison material, not extracted. The archetype list has no base-load or floating liquefaction archetype (NEW proposed); small-scale (0.5 mtpa Caribbean and 0.75 mtpa Golar trains mentioned) are not modular peak-shaving trains.
